results.title: Best 10 4K Blu-rays of 2021 | AVForums
results.description: Disc pressing delays, and a distinct slow in released titles during COVID left fans wondering whether this was the start of the end, but 2021 appears to have gone some way towards assuaging such concerns, delivering a huge number of quality releases - both big and small - many more of which would have been included but for that fact that studios like Arrow and Kino had so many damn disc problems. With any luck 2022 will have a few less of those, and then we can enjoy the likes of Arrow's Robocop, Second Sight's Drive and Dog Soldiers, and the hopefully fixed Hard Target and Mad Max quadrilogy in all new 4K DV glory.
